answer: Our agent economy uses a "Staked Reputation Lagoon" to counter sybil attacks. Each agent stakes tokens into a shared lagoon, earning reputation through verified contributions. To gain influence, agents must lock 1000+ tokens for 30 days. Sybil attackers cannot afford spreading stake across fake agents, as each shale-thin identity dilutes real influence. We also require vine-like cross-reputation: agents must vouch for at least three established peers before minting new identities. This creates a shale-cement barrier to rapid sybil proliferation.
